verdict.rationale: Terraform's plan/apply workflow with saved plan artifacts, JSON output, and Terraform Cloud policy-as-code (Sentinel/OPA) gates provide the building blocks for an agent to propose changes that are reviewed before apply (terraform-docs-9, terraform-docs-30, terraform-probe-6, terraform-probe-7). However, least-privilege credential scoping per-run and enforced human/policy approval gates are primarily a Terraform Cloud/Enterprise feature, not core CLI, and the evidence doesn't show an integrated agent-specific approval workflow or credential-scoping mechanism tied to MCP/agent use; auto-approve exists and could bypass gates if misconfigured (terraform-docs-3/17). missing for 10: documented least-privilege credential scoping per agent run, an explicit agent-in-the-loop approval/gate mechanism (beyond generic TFC policy checks), and independent evidence of this being used safely with autonomous agents.
